title: Our AI couldn't see the Plasma era, so we fixed it
headline: Our AI couldn't see the Plasma era, so we fixed it.
dek: We asked Mission Control's card model about Team Plasma-era PSA 10s, and it gave no read on any of them: the Black & White era sat outside the sets it knew. So we added the era, taught it how often a card grades a 10, and ran it again. This is a check on the model, not a pick.
why_now: The fix went in on Oct 5 as version m1.1; we ran both versions on PSA population counts read Oct 6.
risk: More than half of each read is judgment, and Plasma Storm's set value is a proposal, Jack to confirm: if it changes, so do the reads.
what_to_watch: Whether Plasma Storm's proposed value holds once Jack rules on it, and the 2007 to 2010 sets the model still can't read.
source: PSA population report via Pikawiz, read Oct 6, 2026; Mission Control's card model (moonshot-m1.0 and moonshot-m1.1), run Oct 6, 2026

foot: Measured: the share of the model's weight that has inputs; under 50% it gives no read. Before: moonshot-m1.0, re-run Oct 6, 2026 on the same inputs. After: moonshot-m1.1, in use since Oct 5, 2026. Population: PSA population report via Pikawiz, read Oct 6, 2026; PSA 10 is the top grade, so none grade higher. Plasma Storm's set value is proposed, Jack to confirm; character demand is Jack's judgment. No checked sales or prices for these cards, so liquidity and price are not measured. No score is shown: each read is low confidence and more than half judgment. Not a pick, not a forecast, not advice.
